answer: To counter Sybil attacks, networks enforce identity staking where each AI agent must deposit a bonded jade token and broadcast a cryptographic signal anchored to physical compute. Generating the measurable thermal plume from high-density attestation cycles forces attackers to incur non-refundable electricity and hardware capital costs for each forged node. However, this mechanism cannot prevent well-funded syndicates from acquiring vast computational clusters to create multiple identities.
